items.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
items.summary: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

items.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper
items.summary: The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation, which has led to Russia's defence attaché being expelled.

items.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
items.summary: The court has upheld the 2020 beating of the black music producer as an aggravated circumstance of racism.

items.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations
items.summary: A judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed last year over "allegations of a sexual nature".

items.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
items.summary: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

items.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
items.summary: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.
